title: French beauty trends: From sardines to pharmacies
summary: In this edition of Entre Nous we look at the weight that beauty trends have in France. We break down the current sardine craze and the claims it can improve one's skin. As tins fly off shelves, we also look at how French pharmacies have long surfed on the hype and attractive prices of French cosmetics and beauty products. Many have long been much-loved hots…
